programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(佘诗曼)。顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: 飞常日志
programme.desc: 香港国际机场自九八年迁往赤鱲角，廿五年来客运量攀升三倍，杨尚伟(马国明饰)亦从小职员晋升为中央控制中心值班经理，负责监察整个机场的运作。尚伟还有一班好伙伴，包括仰慕他的助手方可儿(郭柏姸饰)、负责机场客运服务的吕芷珊(高海宁饰)、负责机场保安的陈杰(洪永城饰)及负责停机坪服务的李胜祥(徐荣饰)，他们合作无间协助处理机场发生的各种事情……尚伟与身为港湾航空驻机场主管的前妻张若玲(蔡思贝饰)常有交集，其实二人离婚后仍想着对方，当中机长郭启光(朱敏瀚饰)和空服员高雅雯(刘颖旋饰)的出现，令二人关系再起波澜。

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.title: 使徒行者
programme.desc: 总督察卓凯(苗侨伟)因战友死亡，发现一直联系的五名卧底全部失踪，由于他们掌握高度机密，卓凯决意追寻，卧底的黑白两道身分交错复杂，人人皆宣称为正义而战，但真正的正义又是谁来主宰？

programme.title: 食为奴
programme.desc: 高天宝(王祖蓝)自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫(胡诺言)流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪(万绮雯)、京城第一美女年若碧(胡定欣)、少女厨神米小鱼(何雁诗)等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛(黄智贤)，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭(林盛斌)，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩(张继聪)策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗……

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融、地产、商业是「贴地」举动，富二代王子菲(龚嘉欣饰)却偏爱「离地」，与好友许正伟(陈智燊饰)开设初创科技公司。一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希(张振朗饰)的厉害，邀他加入公司。信希是一名「离地」毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱(刘佩钥饰)帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫……子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤(李国麟饰)、弟王梓龙(罗梓龙饰)、信希之妹丁信恩(黄心颖饰)身上！

programme.title: 溏心风暴3
programme.desc: 凌丽荧(李司棋)与丈夫黄永正(夏雨)凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风(黄宗泽)更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟(李国麟)助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华(关菊英)及亲弟梁赞(阮兆祥)大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧(米雪)有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议。可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家(王浩信)与许家独生女许贝儿(岑丽香)相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱(陈敏之)与有妇之夫郑立安(唐文龙)的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文(黄翠如)关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴……

programme.title: 溏心风暴3
programme.desc: 凌丽荧(李司棋)与丈夫黄永正(夏雨)凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风(黄宗泽)更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟(李国麟)助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华(关菊英)及亲弟梁赞(阮兆祥)大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧(米雪)有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议。可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家(王浩信)与许家独生女许贝儿(岑丽香)相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱(陈敏之)与有妇之夫郑立安(唐文龙)的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文(黄翠如)关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴……

programme.title: 多功能老婆
programme.desc: 蓝飞(杨千桦饰)是一位美丽时尚、开朗率真的「多功能」主妇，有一个爱她的建筑师丈夫尚剑雄(黄浩然饰)，一个活泼聪明的儿子尚启佳，生活美满。蓝飞还有两位好闺密：女强人万风华(陈炜饰) 及美丽富太马思蕾(朱晨丽饰)，三女的性格和爱情观南辕北辙，爱情路上各有起跌。剑雄全身投入开拓事业，被揭发出轨后抛妻弃子，出走内地。蓝飞像折翼堕地的天使，独力带着儿子生活，遂把没供完的新楼房分租，与高富帅租客荣浩田(周柏豪饰)经常斗气，笑料百出。机缘巧合下，蓝飞由煮妇变成名厨，浩田即化作双翼助她建立厨艺事业。女人因男人的绝情而枯萎，又因另一男人的深情而再次盛放。此时，剑雄回归复婚，浩田亦主动出击，三角关系僵持不下！

programme.title: 醋娘子
programme.desc: 曹青(胡杏儿)与母亲曹曹闭月(黄淑仪)结伴行医跑江湖，先后认识了患皮肤病的计准(吴卓羲)和同乡钱通(罗仲谦)，曹青对钱通一见钟情，千方百计嫁入钱家，可惜醋坊当家钱霜(陈炜)因与闭月有积怨对曹青百般阻挠，计准因病治愈献计助曹青得偿所愿，曹青入门后以为一劳永逸，谁料钱通深爱丫环山楂(岑丽香)，曹青乘机搞乱，反令山楂和钱通意外发生关系，钱通纳山楂为妾，令曹青醋意大发，火上加油。突然，一具尸骸被发现，闭月被告谋害亲夫判处死刑，钱家怕名声受损，要求曹青与闭月断绝母女关系，此际，曹青竟发现有「喜」，却惹来一场休妻大行动……

programme.title: Bloomberg BusinessWeek
programme.desc: Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec bring together the latest news from the world of business and finance by harnessing the power of Bloomberg Businessweek reporters and editors.

programme.title: Alan Waxman Is a Sports Superinvestor
programme.desc: Sixth Street’s Alan Waxman talks about taking a stake in the New England Patriots, international growth opportunities in the NBA and why a historic NWSL expansion fee paid off.

programme.title: Jess Pegula on the Business of Tennis
programme.desc: Jess Pegula to talks about lobbying for change in the business of professional tennis and what she’s learned from her parents.

programme.title: Tracy McGrady Always Dreamed of Being an Owner

programme.title: Disney Entertainment Co-Chair Dana Walden
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets Disney Entertainment Co-Chair Dana Walden and a cast of Disney stars for an inside look at the entertainment giant's global streaming and TV operations.

programme.desc: 23andMe Institute CEO Anne Wojcicki. Emily meets 23andMe Institute Chief Executive Officer Anne Wojcicki for a discussion of the rise, fall and rebirth of the personal genetics company.

programme.title: Inside Jeffrey Epstein's Network of Power
programme.desc: Jeffrey Epstein built a network of elites across finance, politics and academia. By analyzing thousands of documents, Bloomberg mapped its reach and how it widened even as allegations against him accumulated.

programme.title: Tesla's Dangerous Doors
programme.desc: A number of fatal car crashes involving Tesla vehicles has prompted increased scrutiny of its electric doors, triggering lawsuits over whether the design can leave passengers trapped.

programme.title: The Hidden Cost of South Sudan's Oil Boom
programme.desc: South Sudan relies on oil for almost all of its revenue. But some communities living near the oil fields allege polluted water is causing birth defects and miscarriages, raising questions over health and responsibility.

programme.title: China's Controversial $167 Billion Mega-Dam
programme.desc: In one of the most earthquake-prone regions on Earth, where the Tibetan Plateau meets the Himalayas, China is building a colossal hydropower system, pushing engineering and geopolitics to the limit.

programme.title: China's Plans for an Urban Super City
programme.desc: China’s Greater Bay Area will fuse 11 cities into a megalopolis that includes Hong Kong, which Beijing hopes will become a new Silicon Valley. But the plan is part of a much larger transformation.

programme.title: The Race to Build Data Centers in Space
programme.desc: “Data centers in space” may sound like science fiction, but as the SpaceX IPO augurs a space boom, tech giants and startups are betting orbital artificial intelligence is the next frontier.

programme.title: A Dangerous Corner of the Global Shipping Industry
programme.desc: The sinking of the Gulf Livestock 1 was the worst disaster in the history of the live-export trade, an industry made up of about 150 ships with a market value totaling $20 billion to $30 billion.

programme.title: Sex-for-Work Claims in West Africa's Rubber Industry
programme.desc: An activist seeking to address the alleged abuses contends she has been targeted with litigation to keep her quiet, which the company denied.

programme.title: The Rise of America's ICE Towns
programme.desc: Small towns are at the center of President Donald Trump's mass deportation campaign, spearheaded by ICE. In one rural New Mexico county, officials are grappling with what it means to be an ICE town.

programme.desc: Anthropic Co-Founders Dario and Daniela Amodei (Part 1). Emily meets Anthropic co-founders Dario and Daniela Amodei for a rare, in-depth discussion of the startup's origin story.

programme.title: Anthropic Co-Founders Dario and Daniela Amodei (Part 2)
programme.desc: A Bloomberg Originals series hosted by Emily Chang that goes behind the scenes with founders, influencers and innovators.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei
programme.desc: Emily Chang sits down with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei in a wide-ranging interview discussing his San Francisco roots, the race against OpenAI, the Pentagon standoff and AI’s endgame.

programme.title: Jennifer Doudna on CRISPR Gene Editing
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets Nobel Prize-winning scientist and University of California, Berkeley, Professor Jennifer Doudna to discuss the origins of CRISPR, other breakthroughs in gene editing and what Silicon Valley gets wrong about the future of biology.

programme.title: Karlie Kloss on Reviving Magazines
programme.desc: Emily Chang goes inside the world of supermodel-turned-entrepreneur Karlie Kloss to explore how she’s trying to revive magazine publishing.

programme.title: Inside the Legal Fight Against Trump's Deportation Campaign
programme.desc: A year following a group of lawyers as they sue the Department of Homeland Security and scramble to help free those arrested under Donald Trump's immigration policies.

programme.title: The Making of a Chinese Spy
programme.desc: Ji Chaoqun was a promising young engineer from Beijing heading to the US to study. Then China’s spy agency came calling with bags of cash, the promise of glory and an offer that would change his life forever.

programme.title: Corruption as Cancer
programme.desc: The Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission is supposed to root out graft. Instead, some of its members have been accused of perpetuating the very wrongdoing they were meant to stop.

programme.title: The Deadly Quest for Gold in South Africa
programme.desc: Gold built South Africa, but mining kills some who dig for it. In Stilfontein, a disaster that trapped miners underground reveals how a quest for gold became a story of hunger, survival and death.

programme.title: The Scandal That Rocked the Philippines
programme.desc: A police raid in a small town in the Philippines revealed a young mayor's alleged connections to a $2 billion Singapore money laundering scandal and Chinese espionage.

programme.title: The Zombie Debts Making Wall Street Rich
programme.desc: A police raid in a small town in the Philippines revealed a young mayor's alleged connections to a $2 billion Singapore money laundering scandal and Chinese espionage.

programme.title: North Korea's Hidden Remote IT Scheme
programme.desc: This is the story of how an Arizona woman's house became a gateway for North Korea's IT operatives - an underground "laptop farm" that infiltrated US companies and pumped millions to the regime.

programme.title: Alexander Stubb, President of Finland
programme.desc: Francine visits Finland, where the threat from Russia looms large. She speaks to President Alexander Stubb about Finnish resilience and how his country is preparing for an uncertain future.

programme.title: Ray Dalio, Founder of Bridgewater Associates
programme.desc: Francine Lacqua meets Ray Dalio on OceanX in the port of Nice for the UN Ocean Conference. They speak about radical transparency, building and leaving one of the largest hedge funds and what's next.

programme.title: How to Run Your Family's $1.6 Trillion Empire
programme.desc: Francine Lacqua talks with Franklin Templeton CEO Jenny Johnson about how to steer a $1.6 trillion business amid the rise of AI, shifting politics and booming private markets.

programme.title: Theresa May and the Brutality of Politics
programme.desc: Former UK Prime Minister Theresa May speaks with Francine Lacqua about Vladimir Putin, and her approach to leadership in a world seeing a rise in "strongmen."

programme.title: The Race to Challenge China's EV Lead
programme.desc: Chinese companies dominate the EV battery supply chain and are expanding rapidly outside their home market. Meanwhile, competitors are looking to new chemistries to leapfrog the leading tech.

programme.title: The Race to Merge AI With Humanoid Robots
programme.desc: Humanoid robots that use AI are going mainstream, but they’re far from proven. With billions of dollars invested, can they deliver real-world value or will they fall short of the hype?

programme.title: AI Is Pushing Chipmaking to Its Limits
programme.desc: Semiconductors power modern technology, from AI to everyday devices. Now, global tensions and rising demand are forcing the chip supply chain to adapt.

programme.title: The Race to Fuel a Nuclear Energy Comeback
programme.desc: Nuclear power is attempting a comeback, but producing the necessary fuel is complex. From mining to enrichment, can new technologies and supply chains scale to power the next generation of reactors?

programme.title: The Business of Adapting to Flood Risk
programme.desc: Flooding is rising worldwide, driving a global push for climate adaptation. From tunnels to seawalls to fly farms, can these solutions keep up with accelerating global warming?

programme.title: Transforming the Electrical Grid to Power AI
programme.desc: AI’s rapid growth is pushing global energy demand skyward, forcing electrical grids to expand and modernize. Now, companies from China to Nigeria are investing in new tech to power the future.

programme.title: How Liquid Death Turned Advertising on Its Head
programme.desc: Liquid Death was founded on the idea of breaking the norms of traditional marketing. We speak to CMO Dan Murphy about the water company's origin as a "sheep in wolf's clothing."

programme.title: How Marketers are Trying to Read Your Mind
programme.desc: We speak with Pranav Yadav, CEO of Neuro-Insight, about the marketing intelligence his company is gleaning from neuroscience.

programme.title: How Mattel Turned Decades-Old Toys Into Gold
programme.desc: Lisa McKnight, Mattel's chief brand officer, has been at the forefront of reviving the iconic Barbie. Now the famous toy brand has launched itself beyond store shelves and onto the silver screen.

programme.title: How McLaren Racing's CEO Runs a Top Formula 1 Team
programme.desc: McLaren Racing CEO Zak Brown discusses the technology, data and effort required to propel the McLaren brand onto the modern F1 stage and into living rooms around the globe.

programme.title: How AI Could Change the Advertising Business
programme.desc: Stephan Pretorious, chief technology officer of WPP, unpacks the world of generative artificial intelligence and its potential impact, both positive and negative, on marketing.

programme.title: How an Underdog Sports League Got Millions Watching
programme.desc: From immersive experiences to live streaming, National Women's Soccer League Chief Marketing and Commercial Officer Julie Haddon discusses the opportunities for growing women's professional sports.

programme.title: Week in the Life of an F1 Driver
programme.desc: Jason Kelly follows Pierre Gasly from Alpine Headquarters to a Paris photo shoot to get a firsthand look at how the business of being an F1 driver goes far beyond the track.

programme.title: The Future of Ferrari
programme.desc: Jason Kelly heads to Maranello, Italy, to speak with Ferrari's leadership about the coming regulatory changes for Formula 1 and how Ferrari's racing technology informs the road cars of today.

programme.title: Inside the Miami Grand Prix
programme.desc: Miami Grand Prix Managing Partner Tom Garfinkel tackles the complexities of putting on the race, and F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali reveals why it's key to F1's future growth.

programme.title: Inside Motorsport Valley's High-Tech Future
programme.desc: Williams Team Principal James Vowles and F1 Academy drivers' champion Abbi Pulling show how advanced simulation is shaping the future of Formula 1.

programme.title: Super Intelligence
programme.desc: Artificial intelligence has begun to exhibit early signs of agency. Are we on a path to superintelligence? Self destruction? Or is the potential promise and threat of AI being overblown?

programme.title: Animal Communication
programme.desc: Bioacoustics technology and AI are revealing how animals communicate, and may soon allow us to talk to them. What can we learn from wildlife, and should we be talking to the animals at all?

programme.title: Quantum Computing
programme.desc: With the promise of unimaginable computing power, a global race for quantum supremacy is raging. Who will be first to harness this new technological force, and what will they do with it?

programme.title: Water
programme.desc: Water. Our survival depends on water, yet global reserves are rapidly shrinking. Can technology help secure humanity's future water needs?

programme.title: Pain
programme.desc: For some, pain is excruciating and inescapable. But amid the continuing fallout of the opioid crisis, new technologies are being developed to limit and even eliminate pain.

programme.title: Next Billion
programme.desc: Soon, another billion people will be online. How will these new users embrace this technology to transform their lives, and what will it mean for the rest of the world?

programme.title: Robots: The Aliens We Made
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets some of the world's most advanced, intelligent, robots. Will the creation of a synthetic species with human-like intelligence improve the human experience, or end it?

programme.title: Love in the Age of Machines
programme.desc: Can we have real intimacy with machines? Emily Chang explores the future of such connections and the technologies powering a growing market of relationships-on-demand.

programme.title: Your Brain Is the Next Tech Frontier
programme.desc: From brain implants that allow paralyzed patients to communicate to the wearable devices enhancing our capabilities, brain-computer interfaces could change the way we use our minds forever.

programme.title: How Tech Is Breaking the Rules of Biology
programme.desc: From birth to death, tech is stretching the boundaries of biology. In this episode of Posthuman, we explore the discoveries that could transform reproduction, healthcare and how we die.

programme.desc: Emily Chang goes inside the world of supermodel-turned-entrepreneur Karlie Kloss to explore how she’s trying to revive magazine publishing.

programme.title: Keeping Up With the Newsoms, California's First Couple
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets California’s First Couple, Governor Gavin Newsom and Jennifer Siebel Newsom, visiting their home in Marin County and offices in Sacramento to see how they work together.

A story on one of the league's most influential right-backs and a leader whose impact still shapes English football today.

programme.desc: From free-kicks to solo runs, scissor kicks to 30-yard screamers, Goals of the Season revisits some of the most memorable strikes from the 25/26 campaign, whilst paying homage to the Golden Boot winner.

programme.title: 武林风云
programme.desc: 故事描述，武义亲王恃势弄权，为夺紫光剑，不惜害死甘大雄、迫走徐牧，并命其子鲁天霞率恶家奴直闯甘家堡，借吊祭为名，实以武力夺剑。甘氏三女胜男、亚男、超男惶然之际，表亲徐进到访，联手杀退恶奴，但大战中，徐进、胜男等受伤，无恙的亚男遂往飞虎岭邀救兵......

programme.title: 报仇
programme.desc: 玉楼发现武馆师傅封与妻子有着暧昧情愫后，最后更被傅封所杀。玉楼的弟弟小楼得悉兄长被杀后，誓要为兄报仇。

programme.title: 单程路
programme.desc: 李修贤是一摩托车行东主，曾是著名车手，惟一次意外中伤残；他对学徒麦德罗甚为赏识，麦因李之启蒙而在澳门赛车中夺标。李闻悉麦参与非法赛车，予以规劝，惟麦受盛名之累，欲罢不能...

programme.title: 玉面飞狐
programme.desc: 玉面阎罗夏梧与司马秋同为镖局金娄文之义子，后司马镖因偷取两本功夫秘笈而伤夏之脸，并将师父杀死；夏抱初生女儿逃走。夏抱女入山修练，并传武艺予女儿玉面飞狐，命她出山向司马劫镖报仇。后飞狐遭司马擒住，幸为书生徐绳所救。飞狐回山后，父疑心其与徐有私情，把她关在地窟中...

programme.title: 拜倒石榴裙
programme.desc: 年轻貌美的丁芝华为缓解家中困境，与弟弟策划了一场珠宝骗局，并打算将赃物带往新加坡变卖。飞行途中，她为躲避海关查缉，急中生智将钻戒塞进邻座乘客张志贤身上，却在出关后失去他的踪影。无奈之下，芝华只得施展一连串笨拙又滑稽的计谋，试图夺回戒指。

programme.title: 佛都有火
programme.desc: 故事讲述，某寺青年僧人「疯子」，性格疯疯癫癫，行为全不符僧人规范。该寺主持玄明方丈却认为「疯子」与佛有缘，并因应其性格与气质，授以「癫罗汉拳」。「疯子」有了武功后，动辄出拳伤人，方丈只得将其逐出寺门...

programme.title: 娃娃夫人
programme.desc: 三十五岁的男教师林明娶了十七岁的女学生珍珍。两人在同一学校上课，隐藏夫妻秘密。珍发觉林明常被女生包围，而林又发现珍常被男老师追求，期间笑料百出。

programme.title: 无名英雄
programme.desc: 街头浪荡客孟刚与铁虎虽玩世不恭，却心怀侠义。一次偶然，孟刚结识革命军首领万泰，在其感召下，两兄弟决心投身革命。在孟刚女友的协助下，他们成功潜入军阀阵营，智取军火送往前线。然而，在与军阀的激战中，三人相继壮烈牺牲，成为湮没于历史中的「无名英雄」。

programme.title: 欲焰狂流
programme.desc: 故事描述饰花花公子的乔庄与好友杨帆，同时爱上胡燕妮，但杨成人之美。但乔因生殖力弱，故当胡怀孕时，就怀疑妻与杨有染...

programme.title: 冰天侠女
programme.desc: 沈冰红幼时目击父母遭高允及结拜弟兄杀害，双脚更被冻至残废；长大后练就非凡武功，矢志复仇。后冰红与高允次子高天英结识，天英虽知冰红为报仇而来，却对她的遭遇非常同情，主动为她治好脚疾......

programme.title: 我为你狂
programme.desc: 的士司机阿发与少女阿霞相爱已久，但发有神经错乱，霞为除心理负担，忍痛分手; 发大闹霞家并断指示真心，令霞感动而复合。然发却不务正业，令霞甚为反感;一次争执间，发狂性大发，霞流产，再次离开发...

programme.title: 如来神掌
programme.desc: 年轻龙剑飞武功低劣，但在一次偶然的机会下，被火魂邪神古汉魂收为义子，并获传授八式如来神掌。龙剑飞从此脱胎换骨，成为武林高手。为报师仇，古汉魂命龙剑飞下山替他找仇人报仇，江湖风暴遂再牵起...

programme.title: 花团锦簇
programme.desc: 时装设计师史马哥向叶德梅征求她对自己作品的意见，梅却随意提出批评，这让马哥感到非常不满。一天，梅准备出席一场盛大的宴会，于是找马哥为她设计礼服，不料他为报复故意设计了一件小丑装，让梅颜面尽失。最终，史马哥却很内疚并向梅道歉，两人冰释前嫌，并坠入爱河。

programme.title: 五郎八卦棍
programme.desc: 杨家将被敌军突袭，几近全军覆没，仅存两名儿子生还。杨家五子遂逃入少林寺，向少林僧人学习「狼牙棒法」，后来更创出「五郎八卦棍」。最终，杨五郎与众寺僧联手，为杨家将报仇。

programme.title: 乾隆皇奇遇记
programme.desc: 乾隆皇帝微服出巡，希望藉此了解百姓的生活需要，但却碰上连串的奇遇，乾隆更被衙差关进牢狱，差点要被斩首...最后又有谁可拯救皇帝出困境？

programme.title: 魔界
programme.desc: 故事讲述，警局侦缉部情侣探员郑忠与王丽芬同往离岛露营，半夜丽芬忽闻异声，离营探看，突见绿光一闪，随即着魔。翌日，王警官率众处理一宗挟持人质案件，期间丽芬径自开枪射杀劫匪，过程被杂志记者阿古摄得，发现子弹竟能转向杀人...

programme.title: 文素臣
programme.desc: 「龙门七侠」之首文素臣命六侠入昭庆寺探察，他们不慎被主持明空杀害。明空更设计杀害林巡按，幸得文所救。文素臣潜入寺内与明空一战为六侠报仇，林巡按下令官兵攻入昭庆寺，联合文歼灭所有奸僧。

programme.title: 乾隆皇与三姑娘
programme.desc: 乾隆皇爱慕苏州名妓三姑娘，为了朝夕幽会，竟然在青楼挖了一条地下通道直达紫禁城。青楼内外，乾隆神出鬼没，吓破臣下的胆子。乾隆在民间行侠仗义，更在赌坊大破赌局。

programme.title: 金菩萨
programme.desc: 陈氏家族失落的家传之宝「金菩萨」隐藏了藏宝地点，秘密分别刻在三尊金菩萨内。保险员保罗意外地得到一尊金菩萨，另一尊则落在陈氏女儿美兰手上。非法夺宝集团为寻宝藏下落追杀二人。保罗和美兰为查明藏宝地点，历尽艰辛，合力对抗，最终智破宝藏之谜，更勇破非法集团夺产的阴谋。

programme.title: 双喜临门
programme.desc: 朱国栋和李明珠本打算结婚，无奈双方父母为多年死对头，所以坚决反对婚事。于是二人不惜假装自杀。有见及此双方家长最终冰释前嫌，答应二人成婚。此时，唱片公司宣布会为出栋的歌曲版，最终可谓双喜临门。

programme.title: 陆小凤之决战前后
programme.desc: 两大武林剑客叶孤城与西门吹雪将于紫禁城决斗。陆小凤忖度二人素末谋面，又无利益冲突，无须决斗，猜想当中一定事有蹊跷。于是，他决定和花满楼前往京城调查清楚，却发现当中隐藏的阴谋...

programme.title: 82家房客
programme.desc: 延续经典喜剧《72家房客》的成功，本片讲述一羣住在香港唐楼的租客被发展商强行迫迁的故事。有些租客愿意接受金钱赔偿，但有些却坚决反对。收购计划最终又会否破坏邻里间的和谐？

programme.title: 大杀四方
programme.desc: 故事描述，民初北方军阀混战，民不聊生，纷纷向南逃难，三位青年王绪、金正平和鱼汉生，夹在难民群中，来到战区边沿。王因出手营救一女难民，致遭地方民团首领陈祖光的手下追捕，幸得风尘女子红菱所救......

programme.title: 何日君再来
programme.desc: 富家子卓明不顾父亲反对，与歌女雪玲结婚，并因此与家庭断绝关系。婚后，雪玲怀孕，卓明因过度劳累导致视力衰退。为维持家计，雪玲重操旧业登台演唱，而卓明不愿拖累妻子，选择悄然离开。在友人鼓励下，雪玲再次公开献唱，卓明深受感动，最终与妻儿重逢。

programme.title: 大罗剑侠
programme.desc: 女侠明珠的师父遭黑虎帮歹徒偷袭重伤，临终嘱往找故友之女青青，探问失踪财宝。歹徒偷听得遗言，先去劫走青青，途遇「大罗剑侠」周应龙，怒打不平......

programme.title: 女校春色
programme.desc: 化学教师陈子风在一间保守的女校任教，与青梅竹马的李海伦共事。陈在医务所拾得弃婴，后把弃婴带到学校照顾，却被学生谣传婴孩乃陈与李之私生子。陈不但轻松面对，还将朝气带入校园，大受学生欢迎，李亦渐渐爱上陈。但保守派对陈之作风不满，侍机铲除陈。

programme.title: 教头
programme.desc: 河东府教头王阳受地方土绅孟二达陷害，成杀人疑犯，惟匿藏孟家任教头。后王收好武青年周平为徒，却惹孟不满；原来周、孟两大族为死敌，孟觉聘王当教头，实乃养虎为患，遂唆使大盗「一条鞭」施以偷袭，幸王逃过大难，只是受了伤。孟家有寄居少女嘉嘉向不值孟氏所为，且对王很有好感，遂暗中援手...

programme.title: 唐朝诡事录之长安
programme.desc: 【附中英文字幕】长安新帝登基动荡之际，卢凌风、苏无名伪装护送金桃归京，在酥山店布下情报网，破解哭寺、白泽、食尾蛇等诡案，捜金桃至马球致命阴谋，公主争锋下生死一线。

programme.title: 爱．回家之开心速递
programme.desc: 故事主要围绕“熊氏一家”在家中的生活点滴和工作上的繁忙。

programme.title: 蜀锦人家
programme.desc: 讲述了以唐代益州浣花染坊的小姐季英英（谭松韵饰）面对外敌不卑不亢坚守染色秘方，而后又不拘一格将蜀锦独特的织染方法传播海外，最终被大唐封为织染使的传奇故事。

programme.title: 多情城市
programme.desc: 以1960至1970年代九份为背景，述说三个拜把兄弟如何赤手空拳打天下，藉由上一代的爱情故事串连两代之间共同的情感与记忆，深度探索两代之间的价值观差异。

programme.title: 神隐

programme.title: 致命的她
programme.desc: 【附中英文字幕】因富家继承女卷入致命肇事逃逸，一位落魄前运动员被迫顶替其身份，面对舆论风暴。她由此卷入危险的家族权力斗争，在生存与欺骗之间艰难抉择。

programme.title: Big Little Journeys S01
programme.desc: A tiny chameleon faces the journey of a lifetime in a Madagascan forest, and a water vole in Scotland swims across a loch and scales a mountain to find new territory and a mate.

programme.title: Honshu
programme.desc: The central island of Honshu is home to over 100 million people, and its biggest city, Tokyo, is one of the largest urban metropolises on earth. But it has a wild heart - most of Honshu is mountainous. This wilderness is home to an astonishing range of wildlife - black bears, monkeys, exquisite fireflies and even cow demons. But all across this island, from the mountains to the edge of the sea, people and nature are drawn together in the most unexpected ways.

These are among the most dramatic and violent worlds ever discovered.

programme.title: 凌晨两点半2
programme.desc: 依成和朋友到聚魂灵山探险，传说山中埋着千年女尸，千年不灭之阴火，进去的人都逃不出来。凌晨两点半，依成的朋友先后突然消失。在森林搜索期间，依成进入无限轮回的灵异空间，更恐怖的事情却接踵而来…

programme.title: 打雀英雄传

programme.title: 煞面迷影
programme.desc: 当年轻母亲为女儿莫名失踪而苦恼时，一连串怪异的事件接踵而至。这都可能与二十年前的意外亡魂为复仇归来有关…

programme.title: 表错七日情
programme.desc: 一对年轻夫妇因欠税款被法庭下令封屋，限七日缴付欠税，并以房屋和财产作为抵偿。丈夫因移情别恋不知去向，法庭则雇用一个年轻的护卫员来看管少妇。那护卫员竟然与少妇日久生情…

programme.title: 反收数特遣队
programme.desc: 在金融危机期间，绝大多数香港市民陷入债务困境。此时，贵利集团采取无情手段逼迫债务人还款，李探员与其地下部队誓言缉拿这个非法组织的头目。

programme.title: 头文字 D
programme.desc: 本片由日本同名殿堂级漫画改编而成。故事描述十八岁的拓海，每天驾驶着父亲残旧的汽车送递豆腐，却无意中练得一手出神入化的飘移技术。拓海被父亲怂恿参加山路赛，竟在众人错愕之下胜出，一夜成名，之后更面对一连串惊险绝伦的挑战赛！

programme.title: 鹿鼎记
programme.desc: 韦小宝被反清复明的“天地会”被派到皇宫当卧底，受命查探四十二章经下落。韦小宝很快成为康熙皇帝的心腹，但他既要执行天地会的任务，最后陷入两难的状态。

programme.title: 冰封侠重生之门
programme.desc: 明朝锦衣卫贺英被诬陷为弑君逆贼，三位结义兄弟奉命追杀。在生死对决之际，四人意外被冰封于时空裂隙。四百年后，他们在现代香港苏醒。一场跨越时代的宿命之战，于陌生都市再度引爆。

programme.title: 玻璃樽
programme.desc: 台湾女孩阿不前往香港，寻找漂流玻璃樽中那封浪漫纸条的作者阿拔。谁料现实阿拔与幻想的相差甚远，让她心碎失望、决定黯然返乡。就在命运的转角，她遇上富豪企业家陈子午，就此展开一段意想不到的爱情故事。

programme.title: 男与女
programme.desc: 偷渡客孟思晨匿居于山边木屋区，沦为众男工具，期间结识非法拳师江远生，并发生雾水情缘。后来思晨下嫁中年木匠贵叔，生活虽安稳，心灵却空虚。意外再遇远生后，难免干柴烈火，未几更有孕...

programme.title: 情圣
programme.desc: 终日偷呃拐骗的程胜被贵利王所迫，要与女骗子叶圆合谋洗劫一间豪华大宅。不料却遇上另一群骗子冒充豪宅屋主去偷取屋内的古董，程胜和叶圆唯有扮成到访的阔少和太太。当他们发现对方的真正身份后，决定一起设骗局对付贵利王。

programme.title: 逃学威龙三之龙过鸡年
programme.desc: 富商王百万被发现离奇死于酒店房间，由于周星星与他极为相似，星星再次接受任务，作卧底调查这宗谋杀案。王百万生前与妻子感情早已破裂，妻子因此成为头号嫌疑人。然而，在调查过程中，星星发现王百万的友人林大岳同样形迹可疑……

programme.title: 冰封侠之时空行者
programme.desc: 《冰封侠：时空行者》承接前作，四位明朝锦衣卫在现代香港苏醒。为修正历史，贺英独自踏上了寻找「时空金球」的凶险旅程，却不知自己正一步步堕入精心布下的致命陷阱。

programme.title: 白发鬼
programme.desc: 年轻俊秀，生于名门望族的日籍华人林保，自幼失去父母，与大学好友川村感情深厚。二人都对美少女琉璃子心存爱慕，但川村自怜身世，不敢与林保争夺，林保顺利娶得琉璃子为妻。林保出国公干期间，川村和琉璃子耐不住寂寞，有了奸情。不久之后，林保竟在一次滑雪中意外身亡...

programme.title: 黑白潜行2
programme.desc: 在莱咖国政权交替之际，黑帮头目宋邦企图藉此洗白身份，欲坐上市长宝座。为了筹措庞大资金，他与官员勾结行贿，却仍面临严重的资金缺口。于是，宋邦的得力助手郑咤和打手苏万杀人越货、横行作恶，逐步帮助他巩固权力。正当宋邦自以为能坐享其成时，三人的关系却突然逆转…

programme.title: 七小福
programme.desc: 本片是改编自京剧大师于占元师傅的真实故事。六十年代戏剧文化日渐衰落，但于师傅仍坚持要保留他的戏剧学院。三个少年决意入读于师傅的戏剧研究学院，向他拜师学艺，经过艰辛的训练过程后，于师傅终于成功造就香港影坛这三大巨星。

programme.title: 赌城大亨之新哥传奇
programme.desc: 取材自澳门赌王何鸿燊的真人真事，讲述由1930至1960年代赌王努力打拼至事业高峰的故事。1941年日本入侵香港，年青大学生贺新逃离香港奔赴澳门。贺新起初在码头做苦力，凭着他的胆色过人、刻苦耐劳和聪明机智，最终登上澳门博彩业的第一把交椅。

programme.title: 替身纸人
programme.desc: 警方在调查一宗团伙杀人案时，突然又发生了离奇的纸人杀人事件，嫌疑人一个接一个被杀。随着不断挖出的线索，警方最终发现这背后隐藏着横跨两代人的秘密与悲剧。

programme.title: 倾城之恋
programme.desc: 本片由香港导演许鞍华执导，改编自著名小说家张爱玲的同名小说，是一个发生在日军入侵香港期间的爱情故事。一个内向的上海离婚女子和一个愤世嫉俗的马来西亚花花公子互相倾慕。但因时局动荡，两人多次被迫分开，最终能否有情人终成眷属?

programme.title: 再见七日情
programme.desc: 护卫员阿逊被派往保护富商的儿子，期间巧遇住在隔壁的祖儿，更渐渐爱上她，却发现原来祖儿是富商的情妇。当他俩的恋情被富商发现后，事情一发不可收拾！

programme.title: 裂战
programme.desc: 为了对抗温室效应，女科学家颜欣培育出超级橡胶种子，前往一个荒岛进行种植，希望将那里改变为一片欣欣向荣的新土地。然而，她的前夫决定在这趟危险的旅程中保护她，与她结伴同行。抵达后，他们面临接连不断的冲突，并遇上当地的贩毒组织，一场生死对决随即展开。

programme.title: 花心大少
programme.desc: 严钱声是一名自恃追女高手的富家花花公子，被母亲劝喻要成家立室。他在寻找生命中的女主角时，被两个追女高手挑战。到底他最后能否找到心中最爱?

programme.title: 一代宗师
programme.desc: 这部史诗式动作电影是由著名电影人王家卫执导。故事始于佛山，当时年迈的北方功夫宗师宫羽田公开挑战南方宗师叶问。叶问最终胜出，但后来输给宫羽田的女儿宫二，二人却因此结下情缘…

programme.title: 逃学威龙
programme.desc: 飞虎队精英周星星奉命潜入校园，调查一宗警枪失窃案。在拍档达叔的协助下，他不仅成功寻回失枪，更意外揭发一宗大型地下军火交易。走私集团为报复，悍然持械闯入学校，挟持多名学生作为人质。周星星必须不惜一切代价，拯救所有人质。

programme.title: 僵尸家族
programme.desc: 一群盗墓的考古学家意外发现一个保存完好的僵尸家族，计画将他们贩卖至黑市牟利。岂料在运送途中，不慎撕下封印僵尸的纸符，让沉睡的亡灵苏醒逃窜。然而，当地中医师林正英挺身而出，誓要将它们彻底剿灭。

programme.title: 消失的子弹
